li.label: Armed Trunk
li.description: Arm the vehicle trunk, allowing the vehicle to mount a weapon platform on it.

li.label: Mount MG3
li.description: Weld turret platform and mount MG3 light machine gun at the cost of increasing vehicle mass, allowing for more rapid shots perfect for crowd control.

li.label: Mount M1919
li.description: Weld turret platform and mount M1919 light machine gun at the cost of increasing vehicle mass, allowing for more expanded rapid shots perfect for crowd control.

li.label: Mount PKM
li.description: Weld turret platform and mount PKM light machine gun at the cost of increasing vehicle mass, allowing for more rapid shots perfect for crowd control.

li.label: Mount DShK
li.description: Weld turret platform and mount DShK heavy machine gun at the cost of increasing vehicle mass, allowing for more impactful rapid shots suitable against lightly armored vehicle.

li.label: Mount M2HB
li.description: Weld turret platform and mount M2HB heavy machine gun at the cost of increasing vehicle mass, allowing for more impactful rapid shots suitable against lightly armored vehicle.

li.label: Mount MK19
li.description: Weld turret platform and mount MK-19 grenade launcher at the cost of increasing vehicle mass, allowing for dispersing blasts perfect for crowd control.

li.label: Mount SPG-9
li.description: Weld turret platform and mount SPG-9 recoilless gun at the cost of increasing vehicle mass, allowing for more devastating shots over significantly longer distance suitable against armored vehicle, but vulnerable during reload.

li.label: Mount BGM-71
li.description: Weld turret platform and mount BGM-71 TOW ATGM at the cost of increasing vehicle mass, allowing for more devastating shots over significantly longer distance suitable against armored vehicle, but vulnerable during reload.

li.label: Mount S-5 Rocket Pod
li.description: Weld turret platform and mount S-5 Rocket Pod at the cost of increasing vehicle mass, allowing for more devastating shots over significantly longer distance, but vulnerable during reload.

li.label: Modify S-5 Rocket Pod (Indirect)
li.description: Adjust the turret platform elevation of S-5 Rocket Pod, allowing for barrage shots over significantly longer distance, but vulnerable during reload.

li.label: Mount Howitzer
li.description: Weld howitzer platform and mount Howitzer to the trunk at the cost of increasing vehicle mass, allowing for more devastating shots over significantly longer distance, but vulnerable during reload.

li.label: Modify Howitzer (Indirect)
li.description: Modify mounted Howitzer to shoot indirectly, allowing for bombardment over significantly longer distance, but vulnerable during reload.

li.label: Mount Mortar
li.description: Weld mortar platform and mount Howitzer to the trunk at the cost of increasing vehicle mass, allowing for more devastating shots over significantly longer distance, but vulnerable during reload.

li.label: Reinforced Armor
li.description: Weld a layer of reinforced steel plating to the vehicle, increasing its armor value at the cost of increasing vehicle mass and lowering cargo capacity. Allows mounting heavier turret variant.

li.label: Mount 2A28 Cannon
li.description: Change the main turret to be 2A28 Cannon, allowing for more devastating shots over significantly longer distance, but vulnerable during reload.

li.label: Mount KPVT heavy machine gun
li.description: Change the main turret to be KPVT heavy machine gun, allowing for more impactful rapid shots suitable for lightly armored vehicle.

li.label: Cargo Capacity
li.description: Improve the cargo capacity of the vehicle slightly.

li.label: Engine
li.description: Improve the engine of the vehicle, allowing it to reach higher maximum speed.

li.label: Fuel Consumption
li.description: Improve the exhaust system of the vehicle, improving fuel efficiency slightly.

li.label: Fuel Capacity
li.description: Increase the size of the chemtank slightly.
